[DisjointSet.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/DisjointSet.java:1) now validates vertex accesses explicitly instead of relying on array bounds behavior, and [MstResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/025_kruskals_mst/MstResult.java:4) now uses the shared graph rules for both construction and builder logic.
